name: Create and sell an online course
blurb: Turn what you know into a course: outcomes, structure, lessons, slides or video, the platform, a sales page and launch emails.
description: Build and launch an online course from one request: learning outcomes and backward design, course structure, lessons and checks, slides or video, production and platform, a sales page and a launch email sequence, using the Skill Garden course-design, presentations, ai-video, content-creation and email-marketing super skills in order. Use when asked to create a course, cohort, workshop or training programme, or to turn notes or expertise into a course and sell it.
ask: Create a course on <topic> for <learners>, and plan its launch.
inputs: The topic and what learners can do at the end
Who the learners are and what they already know
Material you have: notes, talks, videos, documents
Format: self-paced or cohort, video or text
Price, where you'll sell it and your email list size

steps.title: Set the outcomes
steps.output: Measurable outcomes and how each one will be checked.

steps.title: Structure the course
steps.output: Modules and lessons in order, and what each builds on.

steps.title: Write the lessons and checks
steps.output: Lesson plans with explanations, examples, practice and a quiz or task per module.

steps.title: Make the slides or videos
steps.output: Slides per lesson and a plan for each video.

steps.title: Produce and publish
steps.output: The platform, the recording setup and the course built there.

steps.title: Write the sales page
steps.output: Sales page copy: promise, outcomes, curriculum, proof, price and FAQ.

steps.title: Launch emails
steps.output: A launch sequence (warm-up, open cart, reminders, close) with subject lines.
